display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Blasters Wrath F
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives the slotted power a chance to inflict moderate fire damage and reduces the power's recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This enhancement's chance to trigger is equal to approximately 5 times per minute.  This enhancement can only be slotted by Blasters and may be slotted into any Blaster damage power and requires the user to be level 50.
power_display_names: Superior Blaster's Wrath: Recharge/Chance for Fire Damage
power_short_helps: Increases Attack Rate, Chance for Fire Damage
